notes:
v2.7.5 Update
PF2e remaining uses: Action and feat counters now match the character sheet, with correct consumption, editing, and restoration. Innate spells show remaining uses and can be restored after exhaustion.
Foundry V14 shortcuts: Fixed an error when toggling HUD visibility by keyboard that could interrupt other modules' shortcuts. Scene-control buttons stay in sync.

announcement.title: ⚔️ Stylish Action HUD v2.7.5
announcement.content:
v2.7.5 fixes PF2e use tracking and HUD visibility shortcuts on Foundry V14.

  • Action and feat counters show remaining uses correctly, with one use consumed per activation.
  • Editing and restoring limited abilities now matches the character sheet.
  • Innate spell counts, exhaustion, and right-click restoration now work correctly.
  • HUD visibility shortcuts no longer throw a scene-controls error on Foundry V14, and their control buttons stay in sync.
